sql.email.insert: INSERT INTO flow.email_queue ( user_id, subject, message, attachments, from_email, to_email, processed, from_display_name ) VALUES ( :userId, :subject, :message, :attachments, :from, :to, :processed, :fromDisplayName )
sql.email.getAllUnprocessed: select id, to_email as "to", from_email as "from", from_email as "fromDisplayName", subject, message as content, processed, user_id as "sentByUserId" from flow.email_queue where processed is not true
sql.email.markProcessed: update flow.email_queue set processed = true, date_processed = now() where id = :id
sql.email.getDefaultSenderByCompanyId: select email_address from flow.email_sender where is_default = true and company_id = :companyId
